description: This file defines a PHP class 'Image_Graph_Marker_Diamond' that extends 'Image_Graph_Marker'. It implements methods to draw a diamond-shaped marker on a graphical canvas, including setting fill and line styles and adding vertices to create the shape.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Diamond
classes.description: A class representing a diamond-shaped data marker for graph rendering, extending the base marker class.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws a diamond shape at specified ($x, $y) coordinates on the canvas.
